name: timer
title: Timer
blurb: Elapsed time display with spinning icon and start/stop/reset controls.
description: Displays elapsed time in multiple formats (SS.MS, MM:SS, HH:MM:SS) using requestAnimationFrame. Icon spins while running. Controlled via loading prop; resets on loading change if resetOnLoadingChange=true.
use_when: Stopwatches, activity timers, or performance measurement displays.
avoid_when: Counting down to a deadline; this is an elapsed-time counter, not a countdown timer.
a11y: Has role='timer' and aria-live='polite' for updates. Display has aria-label. Spin animation may cause issues for vestibular disorders.
